name: sdd-workflow
description: Project-local SDD workflow plugin for agent-only planning, implementation, review-note fixes, and gated shipping.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-only phase workflow, gates, and contract sync
interface.longDescription: Workspace-local Codex plugin that exposes the project's SDD workflow as native Codex skills and slash commands, while also declaring project-local docs MCP expectations.
defaultPrompt: Draft SPEC.md from a high-level project brief and scaffold the next change
Implement Backlog tasks for a change through the agent execution loop
Fix unchecked Architect Review Notes via /work review
Run the Full Gate for a change and merge it to main
Ship a change to production via /ship --release
